summary: AB Private Lending Fund filed an Item 8.01 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing that its adviser, AB Private Credit Investors LLC, and AllianceBernstein L.P. terminated a Sub-Advisory Agreement dated August 7, 2024, effective September 16, 2026, and simultaneously entered a Resource Sharing Agreement. Under the new arrangement, AB High Yield personnel and certain facilities and systems are provided to the adviser to support investment advisory, portfolio management and research services for broadly syndicated loans and bonds. The Fund's stated objectives remain unchanged; no board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or stake is stated.
